        self.next_attempt_time = 0.0

            asyncio.run(self._async_enqueue(item))

            self.webhooks[item.webhook_id] = item
        await self.queue.put(item)
        logger.info(f"Dispatched webhook {item.webhook_id} for URL {item.url}")

    def get_status(self, webhook_id: str) -> Optional[dict]:
        """
        Returns the current status metadata of the webhook.

            "url": item.url,
            "status": item.status,
            "attempts": item.attempts,

        while not self._shutdown:

                # Retrieve next item safely
                item = await self.queue.get()
                
                # Check if it needs backoff sleep
                now = time.time()
                if item.next_attempt_time > now:
